recent.text: I move to adjourn until tomorrow, Wednesday, March 5th, at 12:00 noon.

recent.text: Is there any further business at the desk?

recent.title: Regular Session
recent.text: Thank you, Mr. President. Let me begin by thanking my colleague Senator Martins for pointing out how thoroughly defeated his side of the aisle has been over the last several years. There's a reason for that. Because the people of this state have chosen to reelect our majority by strong numbers. And part of the reason for that is it has taken us quite some time to unravel the tremendous damage that…

recent.text: Thank you for recognizing my motion to accept the report of the Rules Committee, Mr. President. (Laughter.)

recent.text: Mr. President, there is a report of the Rules Committee at the desk. Let's take that up, please.

recent.text: Mr. President, there's a privileged resolution at the desk. Please take that up, read its title, and recognize Senator Mayer on that resolution.

recent.text: Mr. President, the sponsors of the various resolutions we took up today would like to open them for cosponsorship.

recent.text: Now let's move on to previously adopted Resolution 380, by Senator Hinchey, read that resolution's title and recognize Senator Hinchey.

recent.title: Regular Session
recent.text: Thank you, Mr. President. We have some additional resolutions to take up. We are going to simultaneously call an immediate meeting of the Rules Committee in Room 332, and then take up Resolution 439, by Leader Stewart-Cousins, read that in its entirety, and call on Senator Webb on that resolution.
